other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Generic mention that the smart energy management system could be implemented in chemical processing industries (no continuous chemical production actually demonstrated)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Figure 7 shows the general subsystems of a SEMS that can be implemented in in-
dustries, typically chemical processing and the mining industry.

one_line: The paper designs and tests a smart energy management, monitoring and peak-load forecasting system (SCADA + fast forest quantile regression) for an experimental open-pit mine, with discrete mining equipment such as draglines, jaw crushers and conveyors; continuous processing is not its context.
